name: embabel-me-app
description: Embabel Me sensor app — reads local macOS signals and sends them to your appliance

scripts.postbuild: node -e "for (const f of ['renderer','graph']) { const s=require('fs').readFileSync('dist/'+f+'.js','utf8'); if (/\bexports\b/.test(s)) { console.error('dist/'+f+'.js references exports — browser scripts must compile plain. Remove its imports (see src/global.d.ts).'); process.exit(1) } }"
scripts.smoke: npm run build && node -e "require('./dist/platform').platform.scan({}).then(f => console.log(JSON.stringify(f, null, 2)))"
